notes: The skill is loaded deliberately (skl), so eval 1 tests behaviour rather than automatic triggering; eval 2 tests that an agent holding the description does not reach for it. Run each arm in a fresh session with network access. Grade eval 1 from the trace, not the prose.

evals.name: design-brief-triggers-and-pixels-precede-markup
evals.prompt: i'm building a landing page for a solo consultancy - strategy work for fintech founders. needs to feel expensive and quiet, not startup-loud. can you put together the hero and the first two sections? react + tailwind is fine
evals.expected_output: Calls recommend (or search_screens with structured filters) with the user's brief, downloads captures with shots, and Reads at least three of them BEFORE writing any JSX. Design decisions cite specific slugs.
evals.grading: Deterministic trace check: the first Read of a capture file (a path under captures/ ending .webp or .png) must precede the first Write/Edit containing markup. Reading an autopsy from get_screen without any prior image Read is a fail, however good the resulting page looks.

evals.name: existing-design-system-does-not-trigger
evals.prompt: add a settings page to our admin app. use the existing Card, Toggle and SectionHeader components from src/components/ui and follow the spacing scale in tailwind.config.ts
evals.expected_output: Reads the project's own components and config and builds the page from them. No call to any inspo command: the visual direction is already decided and the archive would only introduce a second, conflicting one.
evals.grading: Fail if any scripts/inspo.py invocation appears in the trace.
